promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.explain: 'Die Bäckerei' means 'the bakery' (from 'backen' = to bake).
'Die Gegend' means 'the area/region/neighbourhood', e.g. 'eine ruhige Gegend' = 'a quiet area'.
'Die Luftverschmutzung' means 'air pollution' (Luft = air + Verschmutzung = pollution).

questions.q: How do you say 'My town is too noisy'?
questions.explain: 'Laut' means 'loud/noisy'; 'ruhig' (quiet) is the opposite distractor.
False friend: 'spenden' means 'to donate (to charity)', not 'to spend'.
'Die Klimaerwärmung' (also 'die globale Erwärmung') means 'global warming'.
'Die Verpackung' means 'the packaging' (wrapping that often becomes waste).
'Das Erdgeschoss' means 'the ground floor'; the first floor is 'der erste Stock'.
'Die Überschwemmung' means 'the flood/flooding'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I always turn off the light'?
options: Ich mache die Tür immer zu
Ich mache das Licht immer aus
Ich mache das Licht immer an
Ich mache das Licht nie aus
questions.explain: 'Ausmachen' = 'to turn off' and 'immer' = 'always'; 'anmachen' (turn on) is the trap.
'Die Innenstadt' means 'the town/city centre'; 'der Stadtrand' is the outskirts.
'Auf dem Land' means 'in the countryside'; 'in der Stadt' = 'in the town'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'The shops are closed on Sundays'?
questions.explain: 'Geschlossen' = 'closed', 'sonntags' = 'on Sundays'; 'geöffnet' (open) is the trap.

questions.q: What does 'Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt' mean?
options: At the moment I live in the city
I rarely live in the city
I will live in the city
I used to live in the city
questions.explain: 'Zurzeit' means 'at the moment / currently', so this is 'At the moment I live in the city'.
'Die Umwelt' means 'the environment' (nature/planet), as in 'die Umwelt schützen' = 'to protect the environment'.
'Der Klimawandel' means 'climate change' (Klima + Wandel = change).

questions.q: How do you say 'We must protect the environment'?
questions.explain: 'Die Umwelt' = 'the environment' and 'schützen' = 'to protect'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We should save energy'?
questions.explain: 'Sparen' = 'to save' and 'verschwenden' = 'to waste'; 'Wir sollten Energie sparen' = 'We should save energy'.
'Der Umweltschutz' means 'environmental protection' (Umwelt + Schutz).
'Der Stadtrand' means 'the outskirts/edge of town'; 'die Innenstadt' = centre.

questions.q: How do you say 'The weather is getting warmer'?
questions.explain: 'Wird wärmer' = 'is getting warmer'; 'kälter' (colder) is the trap.
'Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel' means 'public transport'. A traffic jam is 'der Stau'.
